name: aidlc-team
description: A team of AI-DLC expert agents on Kiro Crew: from a one-sentence requirement through human gates, company checks and an independent review to a local deployment, with a live team board and a CTO view.
author: JiaDe-Wu
highlights: Turns one sentence into a delivery: roles work in parallel, each in its own git worktree and branch
A person decides at the gates: scope, build start and release, with each open question put one by one
Company checks run by the app, not by the agents; failures go back to the role that owns them
An independent read-only reviewer reads the whole diff before the release gate
At the last gate you tick which lessons to keep; later runs read them
A live team board, a replay of finished runs and a CTO view of all deliveries
useCases: Taking a web feature from a requirement to a reviewed local deployment with people deciding at the gates
Trying AI-DLC on your own standards: the team, the checks and the knowledge are plain files you replace
Showing a team how much of a delivery can run without a person, and where a person must decide

zh-CN.description: 一支 AI-DLC 专家 agent 团队：从一句话需求出发，经过人的关卡、公司检查和独立评审，到本机部署；带实时团队看板和 CTO 视图。
